interface.name: zwwm_layout_manager_v1
interface.description: One provider owns tiled placement for all outputs and active tags. Popups, floating dialogs, floating geometry, and interactive move/resize remain compositor-owned. Provider loss restores built-in tiled layouts.

interface.name: zwwm_layout_provider_v1
interface.description: Each request identifies output, tag, work area, and participating windows, excluding floating windows and popups. Tiled fullscreen windows retain a slot but display at compositor-controlled fullscreen geometry. Rectangles describe outer frames in global logical coordinates. Commit must place every participant exactly once. New requests invalidate old serials for that output/tag. While waiting, last accepted placements remain visible; new windows use provisional geometry. The compositor never blocks on a layout client.

request.name: commit
request.description: Animate is 0 for interactive updates and 1 for animated reflows. Failed or stale commits leave the last accepted layout unchanged.
